name: o9401

parameterName.description: Place parameter to use for the search string.

resource.description: ID of the resource for the unfiltered list of articles to subscribe to.
ID of the resource under which the filtered list of articles is published.

description: In the current content pipeline, the query string to be used for navigation is defined by the parameter **search.term**. All incoming articles are consumed from the unfiltered feed located at **topic/articles/unfiltered**, where they are processed according to the applied filters. Once the filtering is complete, the refined set of articles is published to the outlet **topic/articles/filtered** for downstream consumption.
